en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a European spa town promenade along a narrow river. On the right is a long colonnade building with statues on the roof and people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing strolling beneath its arches. On the left, multi‑storey townhouses line the river, and steep hills with villas rise in the background. Several shop signs in German are visible, including a pharmacy sign and another hanging sign on the colonnade.
